summary: Junos CLI (network_cli) works only for junos_netconf, junos_command and junos_ping, while NETCONF (netconf) works for all modules except junos_netconf. Both use SSH keys or -u/-k via bastion, no enable mode, and NETCONF returns json, text or xml structures.
questions: Which Junos modules work over network_cli?
Do I need NETCONF for most Junos modules?
How is Junos NETCONF output structured?

answer_card.title: Junos connection options
answer_card.answer_md:
| | CLI | NETCONF |
|---|---|---|
| Modules | only `junos_netconf`, `junos_command`, `junos_ping` | all except `junos_netconf` |
| Protocol | SSH | XML over SSH |
| Credentials | SSH keys/agent or `-u myuser -k` | same |
| Indirect access | bastion | bastion |
| `ansible_connection` | `ansible.netcommon.network_cli` | `ansible.netcommon.netconf` |
| Enable mode | not supported | not supported |
| Output | `stdout[0].` | json: `result[0]['software-information'][0]...`; text/xml: `result[1]...interface-information[0]...` |
